2607.15469.title: FLINT: Fingerprinting Federated Learning Architectures from 5G PHY-Layer Side Channels
2607.15469.paper_summary: Federated Learning (FL) over 5G cellular networks protects raw data but remains vulnerable to side-channel leakage. Prior fingerprinting attacks assume packet-level network visibility, an assumption that does not hold at the 5G Physical (PHY) layer, where user payloads are encrypted and Radio Network Temporary Identifiers (RNTIs) may change over time. However, we demonstrate that PHY-layer scheduling metadata broadcast over the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) preserves architecture-associated temporal patterns. We introduce FLINT, a novel black-box fingerprinting framework that infers FL model architecture families, including CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers, using only coarse PHY-layer observations. FLINT overcomes the lack of network-layer visibility by decoding PDCCH scheduling information, mapping changing RNTIs to physical user devices, and applying multi-view temporal modeling to distinguish architecture-specific training behavior. This leakage is security-critical because knowledge of a client's model architecture can transform passive reconnaissance into targeted downstream exploitation. Extensive experiments on an over-the-air srsRAN-based 5G testbed demonstrate that FLINT achieves a macro F1-score of 0.930 for architecture-family classification. To our knowledge, FLINT is the first work to fingerprint AI/ML model architectures using lower-layer 5G side-channel information obtainable by any protocol-aware adversary.
2607.15469.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習（FL）在5G行動網絡上保護原始數據，但仍然易受側信道洩漏的影響。先前的指紋攻擊假設具有封包級的網絡可見性，但這一假設在5G物理層（PHY）並不成立，因為用戶有效載荷是加密的，無線網絡臨時標識符（RNTI）可能隨時間變化。然而，我們證明了在物理下行控制信道（PDCCH）上廣播的PHY層調度元數據保留了與架構相關的時間模式。我們介紹了FLINT，這是一個新穎的黑箱指紋識別框架，它僅使用粗略的PHY層觀察來推斷FL模型架構家族，包括CNN、RNN和Transformer。FLINT通過解碼PDCCH調度信息，將變化的RNTI映射到物理用戶設備，並應用多視角時間建模來區分特定架構的訓練行為，克服了缺乏網絡層可見性的問題。這種洩漏對安全至關重要，因為了解客戶端的模型架構可以將被動偵察轉變為有針對性的下游利用。在基於srsRAN的5G測試平台上進行的廣泛實驗表明，FLINT在架構家族分類中達到了0.930的宏F1分數。據我們所知，FLINT是第一個使用任何協議感知對手可獲得的低層5G側信道信息來指紋識別AI/ML模型架構的工作。
